title.zh: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
title.en: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning

evidence.quote: the LLM learns to autonomously generate (multiple) search queries during step-by-step reasoning with real-time retrieval
improves performance by 41% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 20% (Qwen2.5-3B) over various RAG baselines under the same setting
leveraging retrieved token masking for stable RL training and a simple outcome-based reward function

notes.zh:
问题：RAG 通常把检索结果一次性塞进提示，模型不会自己决定何时搜、搜什么、搜几次；能不能用 RL 让模型在逐步推理中自主发查询。
证据位置：摘要提出 Search-R1，在推理过程中自主生成多次搜索查询并实时检索；用 retrieved token masking 稳定 RL、只用结果奖励；七个问答数据集上相对多种 RAG 基线，Qwen2.5-7B 提升 41%、3B 提升 20%；代码与检查点开放。
作者自陈局限：只验证 3B/7B；任务集中在七组问答；检索环境与搜索工具固定；没有覆盖开放域研究、多跳网页浏览与生产延迟。
它没主张的：不是所有 RAG 都该改成 RL；不是 41% 是跨所有任务的统一增益；不是搜索次数越多越好。
notes.en:
Problem: RAG usually injects retrieved results into a prompt once, leaving the model unable to decide when to search, what to search and how often; can RL teach it to issue queries during step-by-step reasoning.
Where the evidence sits: Search-R1 autonomously generates multiple search queries with real-time retrieval during reasoning; retrieved-token masking stabilises RL and a simple outcome reward is used; across seven QA datasets it improves over several RAG baselines by 41% for Qwen2.5-7B and 20% for Qwen2.5-3B; code and checkpoints are open.
What the authors say about limits: only 3B/7B models; tasks are seven QA datasets; the retrieval environment and search tool are fixed; open-domain research, multi-hop browsing and production latency are not covered.
What it does not claim: not that every RAG system should switch to RL; not that 41% is a uniform gain across tasks; not that more searches are always better.

specs.方法 / method: 多轮搜索 + RL，retrieved token masking
